ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (dark) to 30% mid-to-high intensity (light gray/mottled) pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tearing/jaggedness on the trailing edge of the right lobe; prominent indentation/missing tissue on the tip of the left lobe.
